The absolute-trend gate is intact on many themes, providing risk control but no return forecast. Macro narrative is heavily AI-tech oriented (12/17 recent headlines); no crowding flags anywhere.
emerging_watch: Tech Hardware & Semis (hk_tech_hardware) leadership may be fragile, not yet breaking down, but breadth is exceptionally narrow (0.167), suggesting the theme rests on a very small cohort of names. While the absolute trend gate is intact (hurst=trend, durability_bar=0.61), such low participation often precedes a leadership fade unless new names join the trend. Condition to retire watch: Breadth expands above 0.33 (i.e., at least one-third of the basket's constituents participate in the trend) and durability_bar remains ≥0.60 through 2026-08-25.
